5 cont.

entrance to the elevator on the 4th floor and the
stairs leading upwards past the elevator (to the roof
garden) are permanently closed by a strong locked door
at a point leading to the 5th floor. The stair-case
behind the elevator and between the 4th and 5th floor
is used as a store by the printers for all their paint,
and substances to make same, boxes, brushes, and a lot
of rubbish. On the third step of the portion of the
stair-case immediately behind the elevator is a sack
of rice powder, in all resemblance to a sack of flour,
same was opened several days ago but none of the powder
had been used. At 9.a.m. 31-8-33, the coolie Taz Loong
Tang with an ordinary rice bowl in hand attempted to lift
out some of the powder but felt something hard, on
extracting same he found it was the already described
pistol. The weapon was eventually taken possession
of by the two informants and taken to the Station.
The pistol is in good clean and well oiled condition
and bears a lot of the powder from inside the sack.
Same has been forwarded to the Arms Identification Office
for examination.

From the position where the pistol was found
it would seem reasonable to presume that after the shoot-
ing on 25-8-33, one of the murderers attempted to escape
by running up the staircase to the left (North) of the
page_data.zh:

5 续

四楼电梯入口处，而通往上方（至屋顶花园）经过电梯的楼梯，在通往五楼处被一扇坚固的锁门永久封闭。电梯后方、四樓和五樓之間的樓梯被印刷工用作仓库，存放所有油漆、制造油漆的材料、箱子、刷子和大量垃圾。在紧靠电梯后方的那段楼梯的第三级台阶上，有一袋米粉，外观极像一袋面粉，几天前曾被打开过，但粉末未被使用。1933年8月31日上午9点，苦力朱龙根 (Taz Loong Tang) 手持一只普通饭碗，试图取出一些粉末，但感觉里面有硬物，取出后发现是前述的手枪。该武器最终由两名报案人接管并带至分局。手枪状况良好、清洁且润滑充分，并沾有大量来自袋内的粉末。该手枪已送至枪械鉴定科进行检查。

从发现手枪的位置来看，合理推测在1933年8月25日枪击案发生后，其中一名凶手试图通过跑上电梯左侧（北部）的楼梯逃跑。

elevator. In doing so he found the passage blocked
at the fifth landing, in his excitement he got rid of
the pistol by pushing it in to the sack of white powder
then returned to the fourth floor and made good his
escape.

C.D.S.211 and C.D.C.230 with Sun Sun Hotel
'Boy' No.57 have continued inquiries by visiting various
hotels in Louza district, also a general-observation
visit has been made to Jessfield and the Ying Hwa Li,
vicinity of Pootoo Road district but no trace of the
murderers has so far been gained.

A telephone message from D.S.I. Bonner states
that examination of the 'Browning's' pistol shows that
same has no previous record. The pistol has been left
in possession of Supt. Robertson, O/C. S/B. for the
present, pending inquiries to try and trace it's owner.

（批：06B 1/9/33）

Officer in Charge,

在此过程中，他发现五楼平台处的通道被堵死，惊慌之下，他将手枪塞进那袋白色粉末中以摆脱它，然后返回四楼并成功逃脱。

华籍侦探警长211号和华籍侦探巡长230号偕同新新旅馆“57号茶房”继续调查，走访了老闸区的各家旅馆，并对极司菲尔区和英华里、普陀路附近地区进行了一般性监视观察，但至今未发现凶手的踪迹。

副督察长 Bonner 通过电话留言称，经检查，“勃朗宁”手枪无前科记录。该手枪目前暂由特别股主任罗伯逊警司保管，以待进一步调查以追踪其所有者。

Sung Tsang Sung (孫長生) age 52,
residing 43 Sing Ming Fong (新民坊), Zung-chin (誠正) Rd., Chapei.
Mingpo C.D.C.No.24 Zee Zeh Sing.
Louza Station 31st-8-33. translated Clerk Sih Yun Pai.
XXXXXX

I have been employed as No.1 Boy on the 5th floor
(South Portion) of the Sun Sun Hotel, Kweichow Road, for
seven years.

At 9.p.m. on 30-8-33, I commenced my night duty.
At about 11.p.m. whilst I was sitting by a table in the cor-
ridor, I saw Mr. Wong and his body-guard come out
of Room No.618, and go towards the lift. On turning their way
in the corridor, three men all dressed in grey silk long gowns,
two of them wearing round straw hats and one with flat straw
hat, came out from behind and followed Wong and his body-
guard from behind. These three men were found to be appro-
ximately 5'6"/7" high, carrying nothing in their hands. But I
did not notice their respective faces. Immediately after
having turned their (3 men) way on the corner in the corridor,
I heard two gun shots being fired, and just ½ minute later,
another two shots fired. When I went to the elevator and on
the way thither, I met Wong's body-guard, who was then proceed-
ing back, holding his stomach with his hands. He asked me
whether I had seen Mr. Wong, and in reply I said "No." At
that time, his clothing was blood-stained, and on being ques-
tioned he stated that he was injured. On his going back to
Room No.618,. I went down in the lift to the ground floor, and
upon arrival I saw Mr. Wong, who was then unable to speak,
lying at the entrance to the elevator. Later I returned to
5th floor, South Portion. I ascertained from other teaboys
that these three men had been occupants of Room No.638 for
three days, however, they very seldom required the services
of teaboys. During these three days, I had no occasion to
enter the room in question, nor had I talked with them.
This is my true statement.

C. White, S.S.I.
31-8-33.
Signed and cross-marked by
Sung Tsang Sung.
page_data.zh:
孙长生 (Sung Tsang Sung)，52岁，住闸北诚正路新民坊43号。
宁波籍华籍侦探巡长24号 谢泽兴。
老闸分局 1933年8月31日。 翻译 书记员 施云佩。
XXXXXX

我在贵州路新新旅馆五楼（南部）担任1号茶房已有七年。

1933年8月30日晚上9点，我开始值夜班。晚上11点左右，当我坐在走廊的一张桌子旁时，我看见黄先生和他的保镖从618房间出来，走向电梯。在走廊转弯处，三名身穿灰色丝绸长衫的男子，其中两人戴圆草帽，一人戴平顶草帽，从后面出来，跟随在黄先生及其保镖身后。这三人身高约5英尺6/7英寸，手中未持任何物品。但我没有注意到他们各自的面容。在这三名男子在走廊拐角处转身后，我立即听到两声枪响，仅半分钟后，又响了两枪。当我走向电梯时，途中遇到黄先生的保镖，他正往回走，双手捂着肚子。他问我是否见过黄先生，我回答“没有”。当时，他的衣服上有血迹，经询问，他表示自己受伤了。在他回到618房间后，我乘电梯下到一楼，到达后看见黄先生躺在电梯入口处，当时已无法说话。后来我回到五楼南部。我从其他茶房处得知，这三名男子已在638房间住了三天，然而他们很少需要茶房的服务。在这三天里，我没有机会进入该房间，也未与他们交谈。这是我的真实陈述。

C. White, 高级副督察长。
1933年8月31日。
孙长生签名并画押。

Loo Vung Ping (羅榮彬), age 43, Hunan, residing
Chapel.
C. D. S. 211 Sung Kyung Vung.
Louza Stn. 29-8-33 Loh Kung Foh.

I am a boy, employed by the Sun Sun Hotel, at the 5th
floor (North Portion).

At 2.30 p.m. on the 29-8-33, a guest came to the 5th
floor of the above hotel and asked me for a room. I took
him to Room 519 and he gave his name as Koh Vung King (高鳳鳴)
and handed me a sum of $4.00. This man was wearing grey silk
long gown, age about 37 or 38, height about 5'5-6", square face,
dark complexion, spoke Shanghai dialect with Anhwei accent.
After remaining in the room for about 5 minutes, the man
left the room. At about 6 or 7 p.m. same day, the man Koh
Vung King came to the room with two others, one of whom, was
wearing blue cotton cloth/short jacket and pants, spoke Shanghai
dialect, height about 5'4-5", age about 38 or 39, long face, sallow
complexion, whilst the other was wearing grey cotton cloth/long
gown, spoke Shanghai dialect, age about 27 or 28, height about
5'7", sallow complexion, long small face. Koh Vung King, after
a few minutes later, came out leaving the other two men in the
room. I was then off duty at 9 p.m. and went on duty at 9 a.m.
on the following day. I was told by the boy who was off
duty that there was a guest sleeping in Room 519.
At about 11 a.m. the guest told me that the room in
question to be discontinued.
I know nothing else.

E. White, S.I.
30-8-33
Sg. by Loo Vung Ping.
page_data.zh:
罗荣彬（Loo Vung Ping），43岁，湖南人，住 Chapel。
C.D.S. 211 Sung Kyung Vung。
老闸捕房 1933年8月29日 Loh Kung Foh。

我是新新旅馆五楼（北段）的服务员。

1933年8月29日下午2时30分，一名客人来到上述旅馆的五楼，向我要一个房间。我带他到了519号房间，他自称高凤鸣（Koh Vung King），并交给我4.00元。此人身穿灰色丝绸长衫，年龄约37或38岁，身高约5英尺5-6英寸，方脸，肤色黝黑，讲带有安徽口音的上海话。在房间里停留了大约5分钟后，该男子离开了房间。当天傍晚6或7点左右，高凤鸣与另外两人回到房间，其中一人身穿蓝色棉布短夹克和裤子，讲上海话，身高约5英尺4-5英寸，年龄约38或39岁，长脸，面色蜡黄；另一人身穿灰色棉布长衫，讲上海话，年龄约27或28岁，身高约5英尺7英寸，面色蜡黄，瘦长小脸。几分钟后，高凤鸣出来，将另外两人留在房内。我于当晚9点下班，次日早上9点上班。据下班的同事告诉我，519号房间有一位客人在睡觉。
上午11点左右，该客人告诉我退房。
其他情况我一概不知。

E. White，巡官
1933年8月30日
由罗荣彬签名。

Tsang Tse Ling (張志令), age 26, Kompo,
residing 44 Yung Ziang Lee, Tatung Road, Chapei.
D.S.I. Tsai Kwei Sung.
Louza Stn. 29-8-33. Loh Kung Foh.

I have been a coolie No.110. employed by the Sun Sun
Hotel for a period of four years. Every one week I change
my duty (night and day duty).
At 11 p.m.on the 25-8-33, I was waiting for call
at the North 7th floor of the above hotel, about 20 or 30
yards away from the lift. At that time, I heard 2 shots
being fired by some unknown person. I do not know where
or who fired the shots. On hearing the shooting, I
immediately ran to the telephone table and informed the
Accountant's office. On my returning with other boys to the
lift we found the elevator had gone downstairs. I saw
no one there.
At 12 m.n. Chinese and Foreign detectives came up
and brought me to the station for investigation.
I know nothing else.
Signed by Tsang Tse Ling.

6. White, 248.
30 8 33.
page_data.zh:
张志令（Tsang Tse Ling），26岁，广东人，住闸北大同路永祥里44号。
D.S.I. Tsai Kwei Sung。
老闸捕房 1933年8月29日。Loh Kung Foh。

我是新新旅馆雇佣的第110号苦力，已工作四年。每周轮换一次班次（日夜班）。
1933年8月25日晚上11点，我在上述旅馆北段七楼等候召唤，距离电梯约20或30码。当时，我听到不明身份的人开了两枪。我不知道枪声来自何处，也不知道是谁开的枪。听到枪声后，我立即跑到电话桌旁通知会计室。当我与其他服务员返回电梯处时，发现电梯已经下楼。我在那里没看到任何人。
午夜12点，中西探员上来，将我带到捕房接受调查。
其他情况我一概不知。
由张志令签名。

6. White, 248.
1933年8月30日。

page_data.en:
Zee Nyon Nei (張尼尼),28,residing 7 Zeh Sung
Loong Seward Road.
D.S.I.Tseu Kwei Sung.
translated Mah Mur Pei.
Louza Stn. 29-8-33.

I have been employed as No.52 Teaboy on the 5th floor
(south Portion) of the Sun Sun Hotel,KweichowRoad,for about
eight years.

According to the Hotel's regulations,teaboys,who are
employed there, do one week's night duty after having
served two weeks day duty. I was on leave on 23-8-33, and
came again on my duty at 6 a.m.24-8-33. We six in all
(including coolies and other teaboys) were engaged to take
care of 19 rooms,being rooms No.620 to No.638 in this portion.
At about 9.30 a.m.24-8-33, I went to Room No.638 for the
purpose of cleansing same. On entering the room, I saw the
occupant of same leave to relieve nature. I did not talk with
him at all. I ascertained from other teaboys, that this
occupant had engaged room No.638 on the afternoon of 23-8-33.
I was off duty at 9 p.m.that date, and I did day duty the
following day. Within these two days, I had occasion to see
the occupant of room No.638 twice,but did not make any
conversation with him.and found him to be aged about 34-5,
slim build,thin dark face,wearing white jacket and pants.
I also saw a grey silk long gown hanging on the wall in the
room,and saw nothing else. I went off duty at 9 p.m.on
25-8-33 as usual.

This is my true statement.

G.White D.S.I
31-8-33
Signed by Zee Nyoh Wei.
page_data.zh:
张尼尼（Zee Nyon Nei），28岁，住西华德路泽松龙7号。
D.S.I. Tseu Kwei Sung。
由 Mah Mur Pei 翻译。
老闸捕房 1933年8月29日。

我在贵州路新新旅馆五楼（南段）担任第52号茶役，已有约八年时间。

根据旅馆规定，受雇的茶役在上两周白班后，需值一周夜班。我于1933年8月23日休假，并于1933年8月24日早上6点重新上岗。我们共六人（包括苦力和其他茶役）负责照料本段的19个房间，即620号至638号房间。
1933年8月24日上午9点30分左右，我去638号房间进行清扫。进入房间时，我看见住客离开去解手。我并未与他交谈。我从其他茶役处得知，该住客于1933年8月23日下午租用了638号房间。我于当日晚9点下班，次日值白班。在这两天内，我曾两次见到638号房间的住客，但未与他交谈，见他年龄约34-35岁，身材瘦削，脸色黑瘦，身穿白色夹克和裤子。我还看见房间里墙上挂着一件灰色丝绸长衫，未见其他物品。我于1933年8月25日晚9点照常下班。

以上是我的真实陈述。

G. White 副巡官
1933年8月31日
由 Zee Nyoh Wei 签名。

Wei Pih Fah (雇必發), age 39, residing at 114
Tsung Yang Li, off East Kuhang Road.
Yangchow                                C.D.S.47 Long Ching Dong.
                                        translated
Louza Stn.          29-8-33             ------    Loh Kung Foh.

I have been a lift-boy, employed by the Sun Sun Hotel, Kweichow
Road, for a period of eight years.

At 11 p.m. on the 25-8-33, I took a guest in the elevator
to the 5th floor. After approx. 5 minutes, I saw Mr. Wong
who frequented the hotel, and his body-guard, coming from the
South Portion (5th floor) towards my lift. He was at that time
about 3 or 4 yards away from me. I then heard 4 shots being
fired by some one at the back of Mr. Wong who immediately ran
into my lift. I was very afraid and started the lift towards
the ground floor, where I asked Mr. Wong if he was wounded. He
(Mr. Wong) in reply, stated that he had been shot. On hearing
this, I shouted to the accountant's office, stating that Mr.
Wong had been wounded. About 3 minutes later I saw two men,
run down from the staircase besides the lift. These two men
& white straw hats
were both wearing grey long gowns/medium build, height about
5'6-7". I could not see their faces because they ran away
with their heads bowed down as if to hide their faces.

They made their escape through the main entrance into Kweichow
Road. About 2 or 3 minutes later, Mr. Wong was sent to Hospital
after the arrival of the Police.

This is my true statement.

                        Signed by Wei Pih Fah.

L. White, D.S.P.
31-8-33
page_data.zh:
雇必发（Wei Pih Fah），39岁，住东库航路宗阳里114号。
扬州                                C.D.S.47 Long Ching Dong。
                                        翻译
老闸捕房          1933年8月29日             ------    Loh Kung Foh。

我在贵州路新新旅馆担任电梯服务员，已有八年时间。

1933年8月25日晚上11点，我乘电梯送一位客人到五楼。大约5分钟后，我看见常来旅馆的王先生及其保镖从南段（五楼）朝我的电梯走来。当时他离我约3或4码远。随后，我听到有人从王先生背后开了四枪，王先生立即跑进我的电梯。我非常害怕，启动电梯前往底层，并询问王先生是否受伤。他（王先生）回答说受了枪伤。听到这话，我向会计室大喊，称王先生受伤。大约3分钟后，我看见两名男子从电梯旁的楼梯跑下来。这两人都戴着白色草帽，身穿灰色长衫，中等身材，身高约5英尺6-7英寸。我看不到他们的脸，因为他们低着头逃跑，似乎在遮脸。

他们通过正门逃入贵州路。大约2或3分钟后，警察赶到，王先生被送往医院。

以上是我的真实陈述。

                        由雇必发签名。

L. White，副总巡
1933年8月31日

During the daytime and night-time of 28-8-33
and 29-8-33, C.D.S.211 and C.D.C.s 18 & 230, in company

all the various roof-gardens, large tea-shops and well-

A preliminary examination by the Arms Identification Section of the bullets and bullet cases picked up on the scene of the crime shows them to have been fired by one pistol, which is one of a group of 12 pistols used in various political murders. It has not been established yet whether the pistol used in this crime is one of those used in the assassination of Ma Shao Wu (馬紹武) alias Lee Kah Ching (呂克勤) in the Siau Hwo Yuen (小花園) Alleyway, Chekiang Road on 14th June, 1933 (F.I.R.1640/33).

At 10.30 a.m. 26-8-33 D.S. Jones of the Finger Print Bureau examined Room 638 of the Sun Sun Hotel for finger prints of the assassins but found none. He also photographed the lift in which deceased collapsed when he was shot and the 5th floor landing where the shooting occurred. These will be submitted when finished.

An inquest was held on the body of Wong Yoong Hwa (董水華) at the Public Mortuary on 26-8-33 when Pro-curator Kwo Wei returned a verdict of "Death caused by injury of bullet wounds in abdomen", and added "Body to be removed by Wong Vang Tsing ( ) representative of the Public Safety Bureau. Three bullets and 4 empty cases to be kept in the Station. Police should make inquiries and arrest the offender".

The contents of the portfolio are being listed by members of the Special Branch and will be completed on 28-8-33.

1933年8月26日至1933年8月27日 见下文。

枪械鉴定科对犯罪现场拾获的子弹及弹壳进行的初步检验显示，这些弹药系由同一支手枪发射，该手枪属于曾用于多起政治谋杀案的12支手枪组之一。目前尚未确定本案所用之枪是否为1933年6月14日在浙江路小花园弄堂刺杀马绍武（别名吕克勤）一案（F.I.R.1640/33）中所用之枪。

1933年8月26日上午10时30分，指纹局的琼斯巡佐（D.S. Jones）检查了新新旅馆638号房间以寻找刺客的指纹，但未发现任何指纹。他还拍摄了死者中枪后倒下的电梯以及发生枪击的五楼楼面。这些照片将在冲洗完成后提交。

1933年8月26日，在公共停尸房对董水华（Wong Yoong Hwa）的尸体进行了死因研讯，检察官郭维（Kwo Wei）裁定死因为“腹部枪伤致死”，并补充道：“尸体由公安局代表王旺清（Wong Vang Tsing）（ ）领回。三颗子弹和四个空弹壳留存于捕房。警方应进行调查并逮捕罪犯”。

特别课成员正在列出公文包内的物品清单，将于1933年8月28日完成。

Throughout the day and evening of August 26th
and 27th, C.D.S.No.106 and A/C.D.S.No.128 accompanied
by one or other of the boys of the Sun Sun Hotel patrol-
led various roads in the Settlement and visited Chinese
theatres, teashops, roof gardens and other places of
entertainment with a view to locating the assassins,
while C.D.S.No.140, during the same period has conducted
confidential inquiries at various hotels and lodging
houses with the same object in view. No results have been
obtained from these investigations which are being con-
tinued. Representatives of the Public Safety Bureau
are also conducting investigations but state they are
somewhat hampered by the reported arrival in Shanghai
of new members of the Communist Party most of whom are,
for the present, unknown to them.

At 11.30 p.m. 26-8-33 a telephone message was
received from the Lester Chinese Hospital announcing
the death of Zee Yoong Ching (錢榮清) at 11.15 p.m.
that day. A Death Certificate issued by Dr. Chu reads:
"Cause of Death. Primary, Rupture of the Right Kidney -
Secondary, Shock". The body was removed to the Public
Mortuary pending an inquest to be held on 28-8-33. The
Public Safety Bureau has been notified and promised to
send a representative. The property found of the latter
deceased who registered at the Lester Chinese Hospital

在8月26日和27日的整个白天和晚上，第106号华人侦探社警探（C.D.S. No.106）和第128号代理华人侦探社警探（A/C.D.S. No.128）在新新旅馆一名或多名侍者的陪同下，巡逻了租界内的各条道路，并走访了中国剧院、茶馆、屋顶花园和其他娱乐场所，以期 locating 刺客；与此同时，第140号华人侦探社警探（C.D.S. No.140）在同一时期也在各家旅馆和寄宿处进行秘密调查，目的相同。这些调查尚未取得结果，目前仍在继续。公安局代表也在进行调查，但称他们受到据报道抵达上海的新共产党成员的阻碍，这些人目前大多不为他们所熟知。

My name is Tsang Tse-ling (張志令), aged 26,
native of Kompoh, residing at 44 Yung Ziang Li, Tatung Road
Chapei. I have been employed as a coolie in the Sun Sun
Hotel for 4 years.
    At about 11 p.m. August 25, 1933 Mr. Huang Yung
Hwa (黃永華), attached to the Public Safety Bureau, and
his servant came out from Room No.618 (engaged by Supt. Tan
Chao-liang since about 24-6-33), south 4th floor of the Ho-
tel, passed by Room No.638 (engaged by one named Kao since
22-8-33) and prepared to go downstairs by the lift. At that
time Supt. Tan was still in room No.618. Seeing them pass
by room No.638, three men wearing grey long gowns including
Kao came out from this room and overtook them. I then
heard two shots fired and immediately ran eastward to report
to the accountant by 'phone. On the way I heard two further
shots. As to the three men's description I cannot give it
definitely, but if I see Kao again, I can identify him.

                        (Sd.) Tsang Tse-ling.

我叫张志令，26岁，高邮人，居住在闸北大通路永祥里44号。我在新新旅馆做苦力已有4年。
    1933年8月25日晚11点左右，隶属于公安局的黄永华（Huang Yung Hwa）先生及其仆人从酒店南四楼618号房间（自1933年6月24日起由谭兆良督察租用）出来，经过638号房间（自1933年8月22日起由一名姓高的人租用），准备乘电梯下楼。当时谭督察仍在618号房间内。看到他们经过638号房间时，包括高某在内的三名身穿灰色长衫的男子从这个房间出来，追上了他们。随后我听到两声枪响，立即向东跑去向会计师电话报告。途中我又听到两声枪响。关于这三人的体貌特征，我无法确切描述，但如果再见到高某，我能认出他。

                        （签名）张志令。

page_data.en:
Wong Tung Wa ( 王華 )
Chinkiang                                D.S. Tilton
Lousa Station        26/8/33             Clerk Liao Tsong Chion.

My name is Wong Tung Wa, age 32, native of
Chinkiang, and married and residing at No.54, Hung Chiang
Li, Sinsa Road. I am employed as a 'boy' in the Sun
Sun Hotel. At about 11 p.m. August 25 when I was
engaged in a room in the very south of the 4th floor
I heard shots fired. I immediately ran along the
corridor and when I arrived at the front of the stairs,
I saw one of the male Chinese (Mr. Yung Ching) who
visits Room 618 came down from the lift motor room
which is on the top storey. He instantly asked me
about three male Chinese and where they were. As
I did not know to which persons he referred to I answered
I did not know, and he went towards Room No.618 while
I went down the stairs. On reaching the ground floor
I saw the male Chinese who used to visit Room 618
(Wong Tung Hwa) lying on the ground in front of the lift.

I look after Room No.638 and the following
is the description of one of the three persons residing
there: Height: about 5'6", slim build, dark features,
hair brushed back, about 35 years of age, speaks Shanghai
dialect with Canton accent.

I can identify this person if I meet him again.
I am unable to identify the other two persons who are
about 35 years of age and wore grey long gowns, spoke
Shanghai dialect with Canton accent, who used the above
room, as I only saw them on one or two occasions, but
the boy engaged during the daytime to attend the room
may be able to furnish their descriptions.

(Signed) Wong Tung Wa.

老闸捕房        1933年8月26日             书记员廖宗权（Liao Tsong Chion）。

我叫王东华，32岁，镇江人，已婚，居住在新闸路洪江里54号。我是新新旅馆的一名侍者。1933年8月25日晚11点左右，当我在四楼最南端的一个房间工作时，我听到了枪声。我立即沿着走廊跑去，当我到达楼梯前时，我看到经常光顾618号房间的一名中国男子（荣清先生）从位于顶层的电梯机房下来。他立刻向我询问三名中国男子的下落。由于我不知道他指的是谁，我回答说我不知道，他便朝618号房间走去，而我则走下楼梯。到达一楼时，我看到经常光顾618号房间的那名中国男子（王东华/Wong Tung Hwa）躺在电梯前的地上。

我负责照看638号房间，以下是居住在该房间的三人之一的体貌描述：身高：约5英尺6英寸，身材瘦削，肤色黝黑，头发向后梳，约35岁，讲带有广东口音的上海话。

如果再次见到此人，我能认出他。我无法辨认另外两人，他们约35岁，身穿灰色长衫，讲带有广东口音的上海话，曾使用上述房间，因为我仅见过他们一两次，但白天受雇照料该房间的侍者或许能提供他们的体貌描述。

（签名）王东华。

Wei Pih Fah (          )
Yangchow                      D.S. Tilton
Lousa Station      26/8/33        Clerk Liao Tsong Chien.

My name is Wei Pih Fah, age 39, Married, lift
operator, native of Yangchow, residing at No.116 Tsung
Yang Li, East Yuhang Road. I am employed at the Sun
Sun Hotel and at about 11 p.m. on August 25, 1933, I
took the lift up to the 4th floor and was about to
descend again when I heard somebody call me to wait.
I opened the lift gate and then heard four shots fired
and saw at a distance of about three yards away a male
Chinese running from the south towards the lift.
He entered the lift leaning against me, so I understood
that he was wounded and immediately caused the lift
to descend. I spoke to him as the life was descending
asking him if he was wounded and he nodded his head.
When we reached the ground floor I heard the sound
of hurried footsteps on the stairs close to the lift
                                  left
so I immediately/the lift, ran into the compound and
concealed myself behind a door. Almost immediately
I saw two male Chinese run down the stairs and escape
towards the front door of the hotel on Kweichow Road.
Both Chinese were wearing grey long gowns, of medium
build. I am unable to identify them as they departed
so swiftly and/did not see their faces.

(Signed) Wei Pih Fah.

我叫魏必发，39岁，已婚，电梯操作员，扬州人，居住在东余杭路宗阳里116号。我受雇于新新旅馆，1933年8月25日晚11点左右，我乘电梯上到四楼，正打算再次下楼时，听到有人叫我等一下。我打开电梯门，然后听到四声枪响，并看到约三码远处有一名中国男子从南面跑向电梯。他倚靠着我进入电梯，所以我明白他受了伤，并立即让电梯下降。在电梯下降过程中，我与他交谈，问他是否受伤，他点了点头。当我们到达一楼时，我听到靠近电梯的楼梯上传来急促的脚步声，
                                  左侧
所以我立即离开电梯，跑进院子，躲在一扇门后。几乎立刻，我看到两名中国男子跑下楼梯，朝贵州路上的酒店前门逃去。这两名中国人都穿着灰色长衫，中等身材。由于他们离去迅速，且/未看清他们的脸，我无法辨认他们。

（签名）魏必发。

S. M. REGISTRY
No. 5226
Date 26. 8. 33

August 26, 33.

My dear Mr. Zee,

I wish to offer you and your colleagues
of the Secret Service my heartfelt sympathy on the
assassination of Wong Yong Hwa. I feel that his death
has deprived the Chinese Government of a faithful and
zealous servant, and has robbed me of a genuine friend.

Mr. Robertson, Mr. Tan Shao Liang and
all members of the Special Branch, with whom Mr. Wong
co-operated, share my views about his sterling worth
and estimable character, and both they and I deplore
his passing and sincerely hope that the assassins, res-
ponsible for the dastardly act, will soon be arrested
and brought to justice.

Yours sincerely,

Mr. Zee Ung Chun,
Central Kuomintang Headquarters,
Nanking.

1933年8月26日。

亲爱的齐先生：

对于董永华（Wong Yong Hwa）遇刺身亡一事，我谨向您及您的特务处同事表示衷心的慰问。我觉得他的逝世使中国政府失去了一位忠诚而热忱的公仆，也使我失去了一位真正的朋友。

罗伯逊先生、谭兆良先生以及所有与董先生合作的特别课成员，都认同我对他卓越价值和可敬品格的评价，他们和我一样对他的离世深感痛惜，并真诚希望犯下此卑鄙罪行的刺客能早日被捕并绳之以法。

您真诚的，

齐云春（Zee Ung Chun）先生，

Remarks.

At 11.10 p.m. 25-8-.., information was
received at this Station to the effect that a shoot-
ing affray had taken place in the Sun Sun Hotel and
that two persons were injured.

On receipt of this information the under-
signed accompanied by D.S.I. Tetstall, D.S. Crossley,
D.S. Ross, C.D.S.211, and C.D.C.s 7 and 210, immedi-
ately proceeded to the address, also a party of
uniform men under S/I Gevan attended. On arrival
further information was received that the assassins
were still in the building, and in view of this all
doors, exits, etc. were closed and guards put on
them, and three parties were organised under
D.S.I. Tetstall, D.S. Crossley and S/I Gevan, with
a view to searching the whole building. Meanwhile
the undersigned communicated with Station re ambu-
lance being sent, also at this time C.D.I. Robertson
was communicated with by telephone and informed of
what had taken place. After this had been done the
undersigned returned to the injured man, who was
still alive, and questioned him as to whether or not
he had recognised any of the men who had shot at him
but beyond stating that they were Communists, he
would say nothing more and as he was in such a weak
state, it was found advisable to abandon further
questioning. Shortly after this the S.P.B. Ambu-
lance arrived and both the injured men were removed
to Chinese Lester Hospital.

On the injured men being removed enquiries
were commenced and as a result it was ascertained

收到此消息后，署名者会同侦探副督察 Tetstall、侦探 Crossley、侦探 Ross、华人侦探副警长 211 号以及华人侦探警员 7 号和 210 号，立即前往该地址，另有一队由巡佐 Gevan 率领的制服警员随行。到达后，又收到消息称刺客仍在建筑物内，鉴于此，所有门窗、出口等均被关闭并派人看守，并在侦探副督察 Tetstall、侦探 Crossley 和巡佐 Gevan 的指挥下组织了三组人员，以便搜查整栋建筑物。与此同时，署名者与捕房联系，要求派遣救护车，同时通过电话与华人侦探督察 Robertson 取得联系，告知所发生的情况。完成上述工作后，署名者回到仍存活的伤者身边，询问他是否认出了向他开枪的人，但他除了声称他们是共产党外，不愿多说，鉴于他身体极度虚弱，认为不宜继续讯问。不久后，上海公共租界工部局救护车到达，两名伤者均被送往华人莱斯医院。

and descended to the ground floor, where, just as he

the staircase and being afraid lest these people were
again coming to the elevator, he ran into the compound

At about 4.45 p.m. 25-3-33, Supt. Tan visited
Room No. 618 of the Jun Sun Hotel, where the following
persons used to meet daily, for purpose of exchanging
information on political affairs Wong Yoong Hwa (黄永華),
Pang Kung Te (彭公哲) (Nanking Political Agents), Lu
Yuen Fu (陸元甫) Judge of the 3rd Department Bureau of
Public Safety and Wu Kai Sien (吳開先) Chief of the local
Kuomintang. This room had been rented by Supt. Tan
since June 25th, 1933, and on his arrival there to-day
(25-3 33), Wong Yoong Hwa was already there, he stating
he had just arrived from Nanking. A little later Mr.
Chia (賈) a judge of the Bureau of the Public Safety
arrived and invited Supt. Tan, Wong Yoong Hwa and Lu
Yuen Fu to have dinner with him at the Hsin Li Che
(新利查) Restaurant, on Foochow Road and Kwangse Road
corner. After dinner, which would be about 9.p.m.,
all separated, and Wong Yoong Hwa stated that he was
going to a Sing Song House. At this time Supt. Tan
returned to Room No.618, and about one hour later,
Wong returned, stating he had visited the Su Yu (素月)
Sing Song House on Swatow Road. Supt Tan then handed
over to him some documents relating to communistic
activities and they discussed this subject for some
time. At about 11.p.m. 25-3-33 Wong took his leave
accompanied by his body-guard, but about three minutes

Sir,
On October 2 Inspector Lieu Huai 劉槐 of the Public
Safety Bureau gave me the attached despatch which the P.S.B.
received the other day from the Metropolitan City Constabulary.
Inspector Lieu informed me that Zah Sin Chia, 石信嘉
whose name is mentioned in the despatch, is a member of the
People's Training Committee of the Central Kuomintang
Headquarters; that whilst at Nanking Wong Yoong Hwa 黃永華
was also a member of the said Committee and that the pistol
in question had been given to Wong by Zah as a present.
Wong gave it to his bodyguard for use in self-defence but
did not apply to the S.M.P. for a license. After the
assassination, the bodyguard, who was fatally wounded in
the abdomen, concealed the pistol before reporting the shooting
affair to Superintendent Tan Shao Liang because he was afraid
that the S.M.P. would punish him for carrying firearms
without a license.
"Inspector Lieu expressed the hope that the S.M.P.
would return the pistol to the P.S.B.

Loh Sih Kya
Clerical Assistant.

Officer i/c Sp. Br.

Chen Cho, Chief of the Metropolitan City
Constabulary, to the Public Safety Bureau
of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai
dated September 27, 1933.

pistol found in the Sun Sun Hotel, investigations
made show that a license for Browning pistol
No. 460598 was issued on February 6 in the 21st Year
(1932) of the Chinese Republic to Zah Sin Chia, 石信嘉

Your despatch added that the pistol bore
seven characters of which five are "Tseu 首都警察 Fu Ching Tsuh

We enclose herewith a sample of our marks
stamped on pistols. They are two small rectangles
bearing seven characters, five in one line on top and
two at the bottom. The five characters for "Metropolitan
City Constabulary" are on the top line and the two
characters "stamp ironed" are on the second line.

(Seal) Chen Cho.

page_data.en:
Extracts from Diaries, re the "Assassination of Wong Yoong
Hwa at Sun Sun Hotel.
------------------------------------------------------------
At about 4.45 P.M. 25/8/33, Supt. Tan visited Room
No. 618 of the Sun Sun Hotel, where the following persons
used to meet daily, for purpose of exchanging information
on Political affairs: Wong Yoong Hwa (苗永華), Peng
Kung Te (彭公哲) (Nanking Political Agents), Lu Yuen
Fu (陸元甫), Judge of the 3rd Department Bureau of Public
Safety and Wu Kai Sien (吳開先), Chief of the local
Kuomintang.

At 9.50 a.m. 31/8/33, two accountants of the Sun
Sun Co. named Dang Tsung Tsang (唐成章) and Zeng Teh
Tsang (曾德章) brought to this Station one automatic
pistol loaded with six rounds of ammunition and stated same
had been found by a coolie near the elevator of the Sun Sun
Co. Hotel where the shooting took place on 25/8/33.

Examination of the pistol showed same to be a
"Browning's" make of .32 calibre, No.460598 loaded with one
magazine containing six rounds of ammunition. The six rounds
of ammunition consist of three of one particular make and
three of another make. On the left grip of the pistol is a
small rectangle bearing seven Chinese characters, five in one
row and two underneath. The five are 'Tseu Fu Ching Tsuh Tso'
(首都警察署) - Constabulary of the capital - the other two
are not clear to distinguish.

The undersigned and C.D.S.I. Sem Kwei Sung with the
two informants immediately visited the Sun Sun premises and
there located the finder of the pistol, one Tse Loong Kang
(朱龍根). This coolie, Tse Loong Kang is employed by the
Woo Yoong Tsang (吳永昌) Painters Shop, Naining Road, and
in company with other workmen is employed on a painting job
at the Sun Sun Co.
page_data.zh:
日记摘录，关于“黄永华在新新旅馆遇刺案”。
------------------------------------------------------------
1933年8月25日下午4时45分左右，谭警司走访了新新旅馆618室，以下人员每日在此会面，交换政治情报：黄永华（苗永華）、彭公哲（南京政治特工）、陆元甫（公共安全局第三处处长兼法官）以及吴开先（当地国民党负责人）。

1933年8月31日上午9时50分，新新公司的两名会计师唐成章（Dang Tsung Tsang）和曾德章（Zeng Teh Tsang）将一支装有六发子弹的自动手枪带到本局，并称该手枪是由一名苦力在发生枪击案的新新公司旅馆电梯附近发现的，枪击案发生于1933年8月25日。

经检查，该手枪为“.32”口径的“勃朗宁”牌，编号460598，装有一个含六发子弹的弹匣。这六发子弹由三种同一品牌和三种另一品牌组成。手枪左侧握把上有一个小矩形，刻有七个汉字，上面一行五个，下面一行两个。这五个字是‘首都警察署’——即首都警察厅——另外两个字难以辨认。

签署人与刑事侦缉副督察长沈桂松（Sem Kwei Sung）及两名线人立即前往新新公司场所，并在那里找到了手枪的发现者朱龙根（Tse Loong Kang）。这名苦力朱龙根受雇于南宁路（Naining Road）的吴永昌（Woo Yoong Tsang）油漆店，并与其他工人一起在新新公司从事油漆工作。

page_data.en:
- 2 -
The fatal shooting on 25/8/33 took place at the
entrance to the elevator on the 4th floor and the stairs
winding upwards past the elevator (to the roof garden) are
permanently closed by a strong locked door at a point leading
to the 5th floor. The stair-case behind the elevator and
between the 4th and 5th floor is used as a store by the
painters for all their paint, and substances to make same,
boxes, brushes, and a lot of garbage. On the third step of
the portion of the stair-case immediately behind the elevator
is a sack of white powder, in all resemblance to a sack of
flour, same was opened several days ago but none of the powder
had been used. At 9 a.m. 31/8/33, the coolie Tsz Loong Kung
came
with an earthernware bowl in hand attempted to lift out/of the
powder but felt something hard, on extracting same he found
it was the already described pistol. The weapon was eventually
taken possession of by the two informants and taken to the
Station. The pistol is in good clean and well oiled condition
and bears a lot of the powder from inside the sack. Same
has been forwarded to the Arms Identification Office for
examination.

From the position where the pistol was found it would
seem reasonable to presume that after the shooting on 25/8/33,
one of the murderers attempted to escape by running up the
staircase to the left (North) of the elevator. In doing so
ed
he found the passage block/at the fifth landing, in his
excitement he got rid of the pistol by pushing it in to the
sack of white powder then returned to the 4th Floor and made
good his escape.

A telephone message from D.S.I. Bonner states that
examination of the 'Browning's' pistol shows that same has
no previous records. The pistol has been left in possession
of Supt. Robertson, Officer i/c Special Branch for the present,
pending inquiries to try and trace its owner.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -
1933年8月25日发生的致命枪击案发生在四楼电梯入口处，而绕过电梯向上盘旋（通往屋顶花园）的楼梯在通往五楼处被一扇坚固的锁闭大门永久封闭。位于电梯后方、介于四楼和五楼之间的楼梯间被油漆工用作仓库，存放他们所有的油漆、调制油漆的材料、箱子、刷子以及大量垃圾。在紧靠电梯后方的那段楼梯的第三级台阶上，有一袋白色粉末，外观极像一袋面粉；该袋子几天前曾被打开过，但其中的粉末未被使用。1933年8月31日上午9时，苦力朱龙根（Tsz Loong Kung）手持一只陶碗，试图从粉末中舀取一些，却感到有硬物，将其取出后发现正是前述的手枪。该武器最终由两名线人收缴并送至警局。该手枪状况良好，清洁且润滑充分，并沾有大量来自袋内的粉末。该枪已送交枪械鉴定科进行检验。

从发现手枪的位置来看，似乎可以合理推测，在1933年8月25日枪击案发生后，其中一名凶手试图通过跑上电梯左侧（北侧）的楼梯逃跑。在此过程中，他发现五楼平台处的通道被堵，惊慌之下将手枪塞进那袋白色粉末中以摆脱它，随后返回四楼并成功逃脱。

副巡长邦纳（D.S.I. Bonner）通过电话留言称，对这支“勃朗宁”手枪的检验显示，该枪并无既往记录。目前，该手枪由特别科科长罗伯逊巡长（Supt. Robertson）保管，以待进一步调查以追踪其所有者。

page_data.en:
- 3 -
The report received from headquarters re examination
of the pistol referred to in diary 5 states:-
'The pistol has not been recently fired and is in
good working order.'
page_data.zh:
- 3 -
总部关于日记第5条所述手枪检验结果的报告如下：
“该手枪近期未发射过，且处于良好的工作状态。”

S. 1 (Liaison)
October 4, 1933.

Pistol found in the Sun Sun Hotel.

Sir,

On October 2 Inspector Lieu Huai 劉槐 of the Public
Safety Bureau gave me the attached despatch which the P. S. B.
received the other day from the Metropolitan City
Constabulary.

Inspector Lieu informed me that Zah Sin Chia, 石信嘉
whose name is mentioned in the despatch, is a member of the
People's Training Committee of the Central Kuomintang
Headquarters; that whilst at Nanking Wong Yoong Hwa 黃永華
was also a member of the said Committee and that the pistol
in question had been given to Wong by Zah as a present.
Wong gave it to his bodyguard for use in self-defence but
did not apply to the S.M.P. for a license. After the
assassination, the bodyguard, who was fatally wounded in
the abdomen, concealed the pistol before reporting the
shooting affair to Superintendent Tan Shao Liang because
he was afraid that the S.M.P. would punish him for carrying
firearms without a license.

Inspector Lieu expressed the hope that the S.M.P.
would return the pistol to the P.S.B.

(Signed) Loh Sih Kya,
Clerical Assistant.

Officer i/c Sp. Br.

S. 1（联络）
1933年10月4日。

在新新旅馆发现的手枪。

先生：

10月2日，公安局督察刘槐向我提供了附件中的公函，该公函是公安局日前从首都警察厅收到的。

刘督察告知我，公函中提及的石信嘉（Zah Sin Chia）是国民党中央总部民众训练委员会的成员；黄永华（Wong Yoong Hwa）在南京时也是该委员会的成员；涉案手枪是石信嘉作为礼物送给黄永华的。黄永华将该枪交给其保镖用于自卫，但未向工部局警务处申请执照。刺杀发生后，腹部受致命伤的保镖在向谭绍良巡长报告枪击事件之前，因担心工部局警务处会因其无证携带枪支而对其进行处罚，故将手枪藏匿起来。

刘督察表示希望工部局警务处能将手枪归还给公安局。

（签名）罗思家（Loh Sih Kya），
文书助理。

特别科科长

page_data.en:
Extracts from Diaries re the "Assassination of Wang Yoong
Hwa at Sun Sun Hotel.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
At about 4.45 P.M. 25/8/33, Supt. Tan visited Room
No. 618 of the Sun Sun Hotel, where the following persons
used to meet daily, for purpose of exchanging information
on Political affairs: Wong Yoong Hwa (王水華), Pang
Kung Te (彭公哲) (Nanking Political Agents), Lu Yuen
Fu (陸元甫), Judge of the 3rd Department Bureau of Public
Safety and Wu Kai Sien (吳開先), Chief of the local
Kuomintang.

At 9.50 a.m. 31/8/33, two accountants of the Sun
Sun Co. named Dang Tsung Tsang (唐成章) and Zeng Teh
Tsang (陳法章) brought to this Station one automatic
pistol loaded with six rounds of ammunition and stated same
had been found by a coolie near the elevator of the Sun Sun
Co. Hotel where the shooting took place on 25/8/33.

Examination of the pistol showed same to be a
"Browning's" make of .32 calibre, No.460598 loaded with one
magazine containing six rounds of ammunition. The six rounds
of ammunition consist of three of one particular make and
three of another make. On the left grip of the pistol is a
small rectangle bearing seven Chinese characters, five in one
row and two underneath. The five are 'Tseu Tu Ching Tsuh Tso'
(首都警察廳) - Constabulary of the capital - the other two
are not clear to distinguish.

The undersigned and C.D.S.I. Sseu Kwei Sung with the
two informants immediately visited the Sun Sun premises and
there located the finder of the pistol, one Tsz Loong Kung
(朱龍根). This coolie, Tsz Loong Kung is employed by the
Woo Yoong Tsang (吳永昌) Painters Shop, Haining Road, and
in company with other workmen is employed on a painting job
at the Sun Sun Co.
page_data.zh:
关于“王水华在新新旅馆被刺案”的日记摘录。
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
1933年8月25日下午4时45分左右，谭巡长视察了新新旅馆618室，以下人员每日在此会面，交换政治情报：王水华（Wong Yoong Hwa）、彭公哲（Pang Kung Te）（南京政治特工）、陆元甫（Lu Yuen Fu，公安局第三处处长兼法官）以及吴开先（Wu Kai Sien，当地国民党负责人）。

1933年8月31日上午9时50分，新新公司的两名会计师唐成章（Dang Tsung Tsang）和陈法章（Zeng Teh Tsang）将一支装有六发子弹的自动手枪带至本局，并称该枪是由一名苦力在1933年8月25日发生枪击案的新新公司旅馆电梯附近发现的。

经检验，该手枪为“.32口径勃朗宁”牌，编号460598，装有一个含六发子弹的弹匣。这六发子弹包括三发同一品牌和另外三发另一品牌。手枪左侧握把上有一个小矩形印记，内含七个汉字，上一行五个，下一行两个。这五个字是“首都警察厅”——即首都警察局——另外两个字难以辨认。

本人及副巡长司徒桂松（C.D.S.I. Sseu Kwei Sung）与两名线人立即前往新新公司场所，并在那里找到了手枪的发现者朱龙根（Tsz Loong Kung）。这名苦力朱龙根受雇于海宁路吴永昌（Woo Yoong Tsang）油漆店，并与其他工人一起在新新公司从事油漆工作。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The fatal shooting on 25/8/33 took place at the
entrance to the elevator on the 4th floor and the stairs
winding upwards past the elevator (to the roof garden) are
permanently closed by a strong locked door at a point leading
to the 5th floor. The stair-case behind the elevator and
between the 4th and 5th floor is used as a store by the
painters for all their paint, and substances to make same,
boxes, brushes, and a lot of garbage. On the third step of
the portion of the stair-case immediately behind the elevator
is a sack of white powder, in all resemblance to a sack of
flour, same was opened several days ago but none of the powder
had been used. At 9 a.m. 31/8/33, the coolie Tsz Loong Kung
with an earthernware bowl in hand attempted to lift some out/of the
powder but felt something hard, on extracting same he found
it was the already described pistol. The weapon was eventually
taken possession of by the two informants and taken to the
Station. The pistol is in good clean and well oiled condition
and bears a lot of the powder from inside the sack. Same
has been forwarded to the Arms Identification Office for
examination.

From the position where the pistol was found it would
seem reasonable to presume that after the shooting on 25/8/33,
one of the murderers attempted to escape by running up the
staircase to the left (North) of the elevator. In doing so
he found the passage blocked/at the fifth landing, in his
excitement he got rid of the pistol by pushing it in-to the
sack of white powder then returned to the 4th floor and made
good his escape.

A telephone message from D.S.I. Bonner states that
examination of the 'Browning's' pistol shows that same has
no previous records. The pistol has been left in possession
of Supt. Robertson, Officer i/c Special Branch for the present,
pending inquiries to try and trace its owner.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

1933年8月25日发生的致命枪击案发生在四楼电梯入口处，而绕过电梯向上盘旋（通往屋顶花园）的楼梯在通往五楼处被一扇坚固的锁闭大门永久封闭。位于电梯后方、介于四楼和五楼之间的楼梯间被油漆工用作仓库，存放他们所有的油漆、调制油漆的材料、箱子、刷子以及大量垃圾。在紧靠电梯后方的那段楼梯的第三级台阶上，有一袋白色粉末，外观极像一袋面粉；该袋子几天前曾被打开过，但其中的粉末未被使用。1933年8月31日上午9时，苦力朱龙根（Tsz Loong Kung）手持一只陶碗，试图从粉末中舀取一些，却感到有硬物，将其取出后发现正是前述的手枪。该武器最终由两名线人收缴并送至警局。该手枪状况良好，清洁且润滑充分，并沾有大量来自袋内的粉末。该枪已送交枪械鉴定科进行检验。

从发现手枪的位置来看，似乎可以合理推测，在1933年8月25日枪击案发生后，其中一名凶手试图通过跑上电梯左侧（北侧）的楼梯逃跑。在此过程中，他发现五楼平台处的通道被堵，惊慌之下将手枪塞进那袋白色粉末中以摆脱它，随后返回四楼并成功逃脱。

副巡长邦纳（D.S.I. Bonner）通过电话留言称，对这支“勃朗宁”手枪的检验显示，该枪并无既往记录。目前，该手枪由特别科科长罗伯逊巡长（Supt. Robertson）保管，以待进一步调查以追踪其所有者。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

The report received from headquarters re examination
of the pistol referred to in diary 5 states:-
'The pistol has not been recently fired and is in
good working order.'
page_data.zh:
- 3 -

总部关于日记第5条所述手枪检验结果的报告如下：
“该手枪近期未发射过，且处于良好的工作状态。”

REPORT

File No. D 3206

Subject (in full) Further inquiries regarding the .32 Calibre Browning automatic
pistol No. 460598 found in the Sun Sun Hotel on August 31, 1933.

Made by D.S. Tilton Forwarded by [Signature]

Acting on the instructions of the Officer i/c Special
Branch, enquiries were made by D.S. Tilton in connection with
the .32 calibre, Browning automatic pistol No. 460598 found in
the Sun Sun Hotel on August 31, 1933.

It is interesting to note that the correct interpretation
of the seal on the pistol when examined under a strong magnifying
glass reveals to us the following inscription "The Stamp of the
Police Bureau of the Capital" (首都警察廳烙印). This particular
seal which is burnt on the left stock of the pistol is used by
the Nanking authorities where pistols are passed through their
bureau for registration or licencing, by private persons and
also officials, this does not apply to officials who are connected
with the Military authorities in Nanking. Therefore the
Nanking authorities will probably have a record of this pistol.

A search of the records of the French Police did not
produce any information and inquiries conducted at the Chinese
Maritime Customs, Head Office, The Bund, revealed that in
connection with the importation of firearms the number of the
box containing same, with the quantity is only recorded. In
the case of a passenger disembarking at Shanghai a record is
kept of the firearm which includes the make, number and owner;
this record however was only commenced about three months ago,
and an examination failed to furnish us with any information
in connection with the particular pistol under investigation.

Inquiries at the Municipal Police Headquarters, Arms
Identification Bureau and the Arms Licencing Section furnished
us with the information that the pistol is not licenced. D.S.I.
Macfarlane stated that he has observed similar seals on licenced
automatic pistols and verifies our information as regards the

主题（全称） 关于1933年8月31日在孙孙饭店发现的.32口径勃朗宁自动手枪（编号460598）的进一步调查。

由警佐蒂尔顿（D.S. Tilton）制作 转呈 [签名]

根据特别支部主管警官的指示，警佐蒂尔顿就1933年8月31日在孙孙饭店发现的.32口径勃朗宁自动手枪（编号460598）进行了调查。

值得注意的是，在强放大镜下检查该手枪上的印章，其正确解读向我们揭示了以下铭文：“首都警察厅烙印”。这个特定的印章烧印在手枪的左侧握把上，为南京当局所使用，凡私人及官员将手枪送交该局登记或许可时均加盖此章，但与南京军事当局有关的官员除外。因此，南京当局可能存有这支手枪的记录。

查阅法租界巡捕房的记录未获得任何信息，而在外滩中国海关总务处进行的查询显示，关于枪支进口，仅记录装运枪支的箱号及数量。对于在上海下船的乘客，会保留包括枪支品牌、编号和所有者在内的记录；然而，该记录仅在约三个月前开始建立，经查未能提供与正在调查的这支特定手枪有关的任何信息。

在市警察局总部枪械识别科和枪械许可科的查询向我们提供了该手枪未获许可的信息。副督察麦克法兰（D.S.I. Macfarlane）表示，他曾在已获许可的自动手枪上观察到类似的印章，并证实了我们关于

of pistols bearing this seal is not kept when same are licenced

        To return to the night of the shooting affray at the
Sun Sun Hotel on August 25, we recall a statement made by a
hotel servant named Wong Tung Wha(王东華) to D.S. Tilton in
which the servant furnished us with the information that after
the fatal shots were fired he first saw the late Zee Yoong Ching
(錢榮清), personal servant to the late Wong Yoong Hwa(黃永華),
descending the upper stairs leading to the scene of the tragedy,
which indicated that he fled from the assassins upstairs.
Therefore it appears that he was armed with this particular
pistol and we may assume that being desperately wounded and
realizing that the Police would be attracted to the scene, in
a panic he quickly decided to hide the pistol to avoid involving
his master or himself in subsequent trouble with the Municipal
Police as regards the carrying of an unlicenced pistol.  Also
he may have decided to hide the pistol so that when questioned
later by the Municipal Police and Shanghai Public Safety Bureau
as to his reasons why he failed to return the fire he would
have been able to declare that he was unarmed at the time and
so avoid any misunderstanding or doubt as regards his loyalty
or lack of courage.
        Following along this particular line of inquiry, at
3 p.m., September 25, D.S. Tilton, accompanied by E.I. Kuh,
visited the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau and obtained an
interview with Pang Kung Chih(彭公哲), Nanking Political Agent.
He stated that the pistol was known to have been issued
unofficially by Wong Yoong Hwa to his personal servant Zee

        回到8月25日孙孙饭店枪击案当晚，我们回顾一名名叫王东華（Wong Tung Wha）的饭店侍者向警佐蒂尔顿所作的陈述，其中该侍者向我们提供信息称，在致命枪声响起后，他首先看到已故黄永华（Wong Yoong Hwa）的私人侍从已故钱荣清（Zee Yoong Ching）正从通往悲剧现场的上层楼梯走下来，这表明他是从楼上的刺客那里逃出来的。因此，看来他当时持有这支特定的手枪，我们可以推测，由于身受重伤且意识到警察会被吸引到现场，他在恐慌中迅速决定藏匿手枪，以避免因携带无照手枪而使其主人或他本人事后卷入与市政警察的麻烦。此外，他可能决定藏匿手枪，以便日后在接受市政警察和上海公安局关于其为何未还击的询问时，能够声称当时手无寸铁，从而避免对其忠诚度或缺乏勇气产生任何误解或怀疑。
        沿着这一特定的调查线索，9月25日下午3时，警佐蒂尔顿在探员库赫（E.I. Kuh）的陪同下，访问了上海公安局，并会见了南京政治代理人彭公哲（Pang Kung Chih）。他表示，众所周知，该手枪是由黄永华非正式发给其私人侍从钱

page_data.en:
Extracts from Diaries re the "Assassination of Wong Yoong
Hwa at Sun Sun Hotel.
----------------------------------------------------------------
At about 4.45 P.M., 25/8/33, Supt. Tan visited Room
No. 618 of the Sun Sun Hotel, where the following persons
used to meet daily, for purpose of exchanging information
on Political affairs: Wong Yoong Hwa (黃永華), Pang
Kung Tu (彭公哲) (Nanking Political Agents), La Yuen
Pu (陸元甫), Judge of the 3rd Department Bureau of Public
Safety and Lu Kai Sien (吳開先), Chief of the local
Kuomintang.

At 9.50 a.m. 31/8/33, two accountants of the Sun
Sun Co. named Dang Tsung Tsang (唐成章) and Zeng Yeh
Tsang (陳泣章) brought to this Station one automatic
pistol loaded with six rounds of ammunition and stated same
had been found by a coolie near the elevator of the Sun Sun
Co. Hotel where the shooting took place on 25/8/33.

Examination of the pistol showed same to be a
"Browning's" make of .32 calibre, No.460598 loaded with one
magazine containing six rounds of ammunition. The six rounds
of ammunition consist of three of one particular make and
three of another make. On the left grip of the pistol is a
small rectangle bearing seven Chinese characters, five in one
row and two underneath. The five are 'Tseu Tu Ching Tsuh Tsó'
(首都警察廳) - Constabulary of the capital - the other two
are not clear to distinguish.

The undersigned and C.D.S.I. Hsen Kwei Sung with the
two informants immediately visited the Sun Sun premises and
there located the finder of the pistol, one Taz Loong Kung
(朱龍根). This coolie, Taz Loong Kung is employed by the
Woo Yoong Tsang (吳永昌) Painters Shop, Haining Road, and
in company with other workmen is employed on a painting job
at the Sun Sun Co.
page_data.zh:
关于“黄永华在孙孙饭店遇刺案”的日记摘录。
----------------------------------------------------------------
1933年8月25日下午约4时45分，谭督察（Supt. Tan）访问了孙孙饭店618室，以下人员每日在此会面，以交换政治事务信息：黄永华（Wong Yoong Hwa）、彭公哲（Pang Kung Tu，南京政治代理人）、陆元甫（La Yuen Pu，公安局第三处处长兼法官）和吴开先（Lu Kai Sien，当地国民党负责人）。

1933年8月31日上午9时50分，孙孙公司的两名会计师唐成章（Dang Tsung Tsang）和陈泣章（Zeng Yeh Tsang，音译）将一支装有六发子弹的自动手枪带到本分局，并称该手枪是由一名苦力在1933年8月25日发生枪击案的孙孙公司饭店电梯附近发现的。

经检查，该手枪为“.32口径勃朗宁”牌，编号460598，装有一个含六发子弹的弹匣。这六发子弹由三种同一品牌和三种另一品牌组成。手枪左侧握把上有一个小矩形，内有七个汉字，上面一行五个，下面两个。上面五个字是“首都警察厅”（Tseu Tu Ching Tsuh Tsó，音译）——即首都警察局——另外两个字难以辨认。

签署人及副督察沈桂松（C.D.S.I. Hsen Kwei Sung，音译）与两名线人立即前往孙孙公司场所，并在那里找到了手枪的发现者朱龙根（Taz Loong Kung）。这名苦力朱龙根受雇于海宁路吴永昌（Woo Yoong Tsang，音译）油漆店，并与其他工人一起在孙孙公司从事油漆工作。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

The fatal shooting on 25/8/33 took place at the
entrance to the elevator on the 4th floor and the stairs
winding upwards past the elevator (to the roof garden) are
permanently closed by a strong locked door at a point leading
to the 5th floor. The stair-case behind the elevator and
between the 4th and 5th floor is used as a store by the
painters for all their paint, and substances to make same,
boxes, brushes, and a lot of garbage. On the third step of
the portion of the stair-case immediately behind the elevator
is a sack of white powder, in all resemblance to a sack of
flour, same was opened several days ago but none of the powder
had been used. At 9 a.m. 31/8/33, the coolie Tsz Loong Kung
some
with an earthenware bowl in hand attempted to lift out/of the
powder but felt something hard, on extracting same he found
it was the already described pistol. The weapon was eventually
taken possession of by the two informants and taken to the
Station. The pistol is in good clean and well oiled condition
and bears a lot of the powder from inside the sack. Same
has been forwarded to the Arms Identification Office for
examination.

From the position where the pistol was found it would
seem reasonable to presume that after the shooting on 25/8/33,
one of the murderers attempted to escape by running up the
staircase to the left (North) of the elevator. In doing so
ed
he found the passage block/at the fifth landing, in his
excitement he got rid of the pistol by pushing it in to the
sack of white powder then returned to the 4th floor and made
good his escape.

A telephone message from D.S.I. Bonner states that
examination of the 'Browning's' pistol shows that same has
no previous records. The pistol has been left in possession
of Supt. Robertson, Officer i/c Special Branch for the present,
pending inquiries to try and trace its owner.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

1933年8月25日的致命枪击发生在四楼电梯入口处，而绕过电梯向上延伸（至屋顶花园）的楼梯在通往五楼的某处被一扇坚固的锁门永久封闭。电梯后方、四楼和五楼之间的楼梯被油漆工用作仓库，存放所有油漆、调制材料、箱子、刷子和大量垃圾。在紧靠电梯后方的那段楼梯的第三级台阶上，有一袋白色粉末，外观极像一袋面粉，几天前曾被打开，但粉末未被使用。1933年8月31日上午9时，苦力朱龙根（Tsz Loong Kung，音译）手持一只陶碗，试图从中取出一些粉末，但感觉到有硬物，取出后发现是前述的手枪。该武器最终由两名线人接管并带至分局。手枪状况良好、清洁且润滑充分，并沾有许多来自袋内的粉末。该手枪已送至枪械识别科进行检查。

从发现手枪的位置来看，合理推测在1933年8月25日枪击发生后，其中一名凶手试图通过跑上电梯左侧（北侧）的楼梯逃跑。在此过程中，他发现五楼平台处的通道被阻塞，在惊慌中，他将手枪推入白色粉末袋中以摆脱它，然后返回四楼并成功逃脱。

副督察邦纳（D.S.I. Bonner）的电话留言称，对“勃朗宁”手枪的检查显示，该枪此前无记录。目前，该手枪由特别支部主管警官罗伯逊督察（Supt. Robertson）保管，以待调查并试图追踪其所有者。

page_data.en:
- 3 -

The report received from headquarters re examination
of the pistol referred to in diary 5 states:-
'The pistol has not been recently fired and is in
good working order.'

- 3 -

收到的总部关于日记第5条所述手枪检查的报告指出：
“该手枪近期未发射过，且处于良好的工作状态。”

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, TUESDAY, AUGUST 29, 1933.

SHANGHAI A KEY
TO PEACE

All Police in Harmonious
Co-operation

STRIKING TRIBUTE PAID
BY THE MAYOR

Shanghai, Aug. 28.
At the weekly memorial service of the Greater Shanghai Municipal Government, this morning, high tribute was paid by Mayor Wu Te-chen to the many faithful employees of the Bureau of Public Safety, such as the late Ma Shao-wu and Wang Yung-hwan, who have been killed in the course of duty.

The Mayor said that Shanghai had been the base of operations of the lawless elements and communists, and, ordinarily, they might, perhaps, expect Shanghai to be always in turmoil, but, in fact, Shanghai as a whole had been able to maintain peace and order during the past year or so.

This was mainly due to two factors. First, a realisation on the part of the majority of the people, that peace in Shanghai is the key to peace in China. This realisation had resulted in the willing co-operation of the people in all attempts to ensure peace. Secondly, the Mayor emphasised, there had been close and harmonious co-operation from and with the authorities and police of the International Settlement and the French Concession in ridding the city of undesirable elements and lawless characters.

The faithfulness and devotion of members of the Bureau of Public Safety had led them to face danger and risk their lives in the performance of their duty in order to keep robbers and communists in check. Due tribute therefore was owing to the men who had sacrificed their lives for the common good.—Kuo Min.

《字林西报》，1933年8月29日，星期二。

上海乃和平之关键

警方和谐合作

市长致以崇高敬意

上海，8月28日。
在今晨大上海市政府举行的每周纪念仪式上，吴铁城市长向公安局众多忠诚的职员致以崇高的敬意，其中包括在执勤过程中殉职的马绍武和王永焕（音译）等人。

吴市长表示，上海一直是无法无天之徒和共产主义者的行动基地，通常人们或许会认为上海将始终处于动荡之中，但事实上，在过去一年左右的时间里，上海整体得以维持和平与秩序。

这主要归功于两个因素。首先，大多数民众认识到，上海的和平是中国和平的关键。这种认识使得民众在所有确保和平的努力中愿意予以合作。其次，吴市长强调，在与国际租界和法租界的当局及警方密切和谐的合作下，清除了城内的不良分子和不法之徒。

公安局成员的忠诚和奉献精神，使他们在履行职责以遏制盗匪和共产主义者时，敢于面对危险并冒生命危险。因此，应当向那些为公共利益而牺牲生命的人致以应有的敬意。——《国民新闻》

August 29, 1933.    Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

"We were taught by our late leader Dr. Sun Yat-sen
that, in order to revive China, every Government official
should be ambitious and be faithful to his duty. A
person who devotes himself faithfully to his duty will
finally achieve success.
"During the past two years, many special officers
of the Bureau of Public Safety have made the supreme
sacrifice; they were faithful even to death. The most
conspicuous instances were the assassination of Ma Hsao
Wu and Huang Yung Hua. Both had sacrificed their lives
to duty. They paid no regard to the disadvantages or
dangers facing them; they were ambitious and eager to
serve the public and society. They died because they
were brave in their duty. Their spirit is admirable.
In our desire to serve the public, we should emulate
their spirit.
"During the present national crisis, many evil
elements are trying every possible means to disturb
the peace and safety with the evil intention of overthrowing
the Government. Shanghai is the place where these evil-
doers aim to start these troubles. However, Shanghai has
been more peaceful than it was before the September 18
Incident. This due to several factors:(1) the people in
Shanghai thoroughly understand the important position
of Shanghai and have worked together for peace and safety in
the district, (2) the special officers of the Bureau
Public Safety have worked hard to clear away the evil
elements and their secret organs from this district.
They have carried out their duties in co-operation with
the Police authorities of the International Settlement
and the French Concession. Thus the peace and order
in Shanghai has been successfully maintained."

Funeral of The Late Inspector Huang Yung Hua.

The funeral of the late inspector Huang Yung Hua
will be held at 2 p.m. August 31 at the China Funeral
Directors, Avenue Haig.
All mourning scrolls and wreaths are to be sent
to the China Seamen's Special Kuomintang, the Inspectors
Department of the Bureau of Public Safety or the China
Funeral Directors.

D 5226

1933年8月29日。上午译文

杂项

“我们已故领袖孙中山博士教导我们，为了复兴中国，每一位政府官员都应有志向并忠于职守。一个忠实于职守的人最终会取得成功。
“在过去两年中，公安局的许多特别警官做出了最大的牺牲；他们至死忠诚。最显著的例子是马绍武和黄永华（音译）遇刺案。两人都为职责献出了生命。他们不顾面临的不利条件或危险；他们有志向，渴望为公众和社会服务。他们因勇敢履职而死。他们的精神令人钦佩。在我们为公众服务的愿望中，我们应该效仿他们的精神。
“在当前国家危机期间，许多邪恶势力正试图通过各种手段扰乱和平与安全，其险恶用心在于推翻政府。上海是这些恶棍企图制造事端的地方。然而，上海比‘九一八’事变之前更加平静。这归因于几个因素：(1) 上海民众充分理解上海的重要地位，并为该地区的和平与安全共同努力，(2) 公安局的特别警官努力工作，清除该地区的邪恶势力及其秘密机关。他们与国际租界和法租界的警察当局合作执行任务。因此，上海的和平与秩序得以成功维持。”

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, MONDAY, AUGUST 28, 1933

BODYGUARD DIES
OF WOUND

Second Victim of Hotel
Assassination

Almost exactly twenty-four hours
after being struck by a bullet from
assassins who fatally wounded his
employer (Mr. Wong Yung-wa,
Chief of the Inspector's Office of the
Bureau of Public Safety), the body-
guard Zung Yung-jing died at 11.15
p.m. on Saturday in the Lester
Hospital, to which he and Mr. Wong
were rushed by ambulance on Friday
night following the sensational
shooting affair in the Sun Sun Hotel.
On Friday Mr. Wong had just
returned from a trip to Nanking,
and had made a visit in connection
with his official duties before being
shot by gunmen who had followed
him and his bodyguard from a
room near to the one which Mr.
Wong was accustomed to visit. Just
outside the lift they opened fire,
immediately taking to flight, and a
remark by Zung to the lift man—
who had the presence of mind to
slam the lift gate and bring the
two wounded men down to street
level—indicated that the assassina-
tion was the work of Reds in
vengeance for Mr. Wong's activities
as an anti-Communist agent.
In police quarters it is learned
that there is no ground whatever for
the assertion that before joining the
Kuomintang Mr. Wong had been
associated for some time with Com-
munists in his native town of Juke,
North Kiangsu. In the discharge
of his duties he had more than once
co-operated effectively with the
Settlement police. Special efforts
for the detection and arrest of the
murderers are being made by the

保镖伤重
身亡

酒店刺杀案
第二名受害者

在雇主（公安局督察处处长王永华先生）被刺客子弹击中受致命伤后整整二十四小时，保镖宗永敬（音译）于周六晚11点15分在莱斯医院（Lester Hospital）去世。周五晚在新新旅馆发生轰动性的枪击事件后，他和王先生被救护车紧急送往该医院。
周五，王先生刚从南京出差回来，在处理完公务后，遭到从一间他常去房间附近跟踪他和保镖的枪手射击。就在电梯外，枪手开火后立即逃窜，宗对电梯操作员说了一句话——该操作员头脑冷静地关上电梯门并将两名伤者送到街道层——这表明此次刺杀是赤色分子为报复王先生作为反共特工的活动而所为。
据警方内部消息，没有任何依据支持这样一种说法，即王先生在加入国民党之前，曾在其家乡江苏北部的如皋（Juke，音译）与共产主义者有过一段时间的关联。在履行职责过程中，他曾多次与租界警方有效合作。公安局正在特别努力侦缉凶手，据悉该局已请求大上海市政府和国民党中央总部向这位侦探的遗孀发放抚恤金。
截至昨日，市警方面尚未发现任何关于凶手身份的线索，但希望最终能将这起冷血谋杀案的肇事者绳之以法，尽管调查过程可能会很漫长。

Dead Agent's
Wife To Fight
Communism

Last Rites For Huang,
Special Anti-Red De-
tective Shot In Hotel,
To Be Held Wednesday

Funeral services for the late Mr.
Huang Yung-hwa, agent of the
Central Kuomintang and head of
the special service division of the
Bureau of Public Safety of the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai,
who was assassinated by unknown
gunmen in the elevator of the Sun
Sun Hotel on Friday night, will be
held on Wednesday at the Inter-
national Funeral Directors, 71
Kiaochow Road.

Meantime, a special office has
been opened jointly by the Kuo-
mintang Bureau and the Bureau
of Public Safety to take charge of
the funeral. The burial expenses
will be borne by the government,
and in addition the government will
be petitioned to grant a pension to
the survivors, according to Major-
General Wen Hung-en, police com-
missioner of the Municipality of
Greater Shanghai, in an interview
yesterday.

Mrs. Huang Yung-hwa, widow of
the late special service man, im-
mediately upon learning of the
tragic death of her husband, came
to Shanghai from Soochow. She
is also a member of the Kuomin-
tang and is now teaching in a
primary school in Soochow.

Interviewed by Chinese pressmen
yesterday, Mrs. Huang declared
that she will devote the rest of her
life doing service for the Party in
ridding the country of the Com-
munists by promoting education.

中央国民党特工兼大上海市政府公安局特别服务处处长黄永华（音译）先生的葬礼将于周三在胶州路71号的国际殡仪馆举行。黄先生于周五晚在新新旅馆电梯内被不明身份的枪手刺杀。

与此同时，国民党部和公安局联合设立了一个特别办公室来负责葬礼事宜。据大上海市政府警察局长温洪恩（音译）少将在昨日的一次采访中表示，丧葬费用将由政府承担，此外还将向政府申请向遗属发放抚恤金。

黄永华（音译）先生的遗孀黄夫人在得知丈夫不幸去世的消息后，立即从苏州来到上海。她也是国民党党员，目前在苏州的一所小学任教。

黄夫人在昨日接受中国记者采访时宣称，她将余生致力于通过推广教育来为国家清除共产主义者，以此向党提供服务。

新新旅馆谋杀案
为近期第三起同类案件

如同马绍武一样，黄永华也是著名的
共产主义者追捕者；杀害两位督察的
子弹类型相同

周五晚，上海公安局督察处处长黄永华在南京路新新旅馆遭冷酷刺杀，这是几个月来的第三起同类政治谋杀案。
几周前，专门从事遏制共产主义者活动的该局督察马绍武在浙江路旁的一条小巷中被枪杀，不久后在医院去世。几个月前，该局另一名警官王平（音译）在法租界乘坐人力车时被不明身份的枪手谋杀。
中国侦探已查明，杀害黄的子弹与杀害马的凶手所使用的子弹属于同一品种。
黄永华是在新新大楼五楼电梯外被枪杀的。两名亡命之徒跟随他来到电梯，当他按铃时，他们开了几枪，使他身中三弹倒地。
他的保镖宗永敬（音译）试图将黄送入电梯以确保安全，腹部中弹。警察赶到时，发现他们躺在电梯里的一滩血泊中。他们被送往中国莱斯医院；但黄在15分钟后死亡。宗昨晚仍活着；但情况危急。凶手趁乱沿楼梯逃脱。
黄是绍兴人，享年31岁。去年他因逮捕一名共产党领导人而受到嘉奖。据说他深受曾在其麾下效力的蒋介石将军的喜爱。他去年被任命到该局任职，一直是一名高效的共产主义者追捕者。
黄在其职业生涯中使用过许多名字——这是由其工作性质所必需的。除了公安局的高级官员外，很少有人知道他的确切住址。他住在旅馆里是为了能与同志们自由讨论事务，但显然他一直受到敌人的跟踪。昨天，住在他旅馆房间附近的几名可疑人员消失了。旅馆服务员说，这些人从不让他们进入他的房间。
黄的遗孀昨天从杭州抵达上海。他还留有一个五岁的女儿。

August 27, 1933.    Morning Press Clippings

MISCELLANEOUS

Lord Marley refuted the press report that
Madame Soong Ching Ling would act as chairman of the
meeting and that the meeting would be held in the
Chinese Y.M.C.A. in French Concession. Lord Marley
said that he would preside over the meeting. It is
not definitely known how long the delegates will remain
in Shanghai. They had to make all the arrangements
themselves and this would take at least two or three
months to complete. Lord Marley added that he would
call on Mayor Wu Te Chen and that he was contemplating
a trip to Nanking.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE ASSASSINATION OF A CHINESE POLICE OFFICER.

The Shanghai Public Safety Bureau has already
reported to the Municipality of Greater Shanghai and the
Shanghai Office of the Central Kuomintang the murder of
Huang Yung Hua(黃永華), Chief of the Inspectors Office
of the Bureau, at 11 p.m. August 25 in the Sun Sun Hotel,
Kweichow Road. The Bureau has issued instructions for
the arrest of the assassins.
The late Mr. Huang was a native of Zu Kao
(如皋), aged 31. It is learned that his real name
was Zien Nee Chwang(錢義璋). Apart from his official
position with the Public Safety Bureau, he was also a
member of the Seamen's Special Kuomintang. He resided
in a house in Zai Tai Li(瑞泰里) alleyway, Shao Chia
Road(肇嘉浜), West Gate.
According to Liu Tai(刘槐), who is in
charge of the Special Affairs Section of the Public
Safety Bureau, Huang had no family and is survived only
by his wife who is at present in Shanghai. Another
report states that Huang had a brother living with him.
His widow is penniless.
The Public Safety Bureau has requested the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai and the Central
Kuomintang Headquarters to issue a compassionate grant
to Huang's widow.
Huang's bodyguard, Zung Yung Jing(秦荣琴),
succumbed to his wounds at 11.15 p.m. August 25.

Chen Pao:

PROTEST AGAINST A SEARCH BY S.M.P.

On August 26 the 14th Branch Association of
the Citizens Federation submitted a petition to the
Municipality of Greater Shanghai, the Shanghai Special
District Kuomintang and the Education Bureau demanding
that a strong protest be lodged with the S.M.C. against
the search of the Chun Yu San Yoeh Society(群和三育会)
by the Hongkew Police Station.

China Times and other local newspapers:

ASSASSINATION OF A CHINESE POLICE OFFICER.

5226
At about 11 p.m. yesterday Huang Yung Hwa (王永華),
Chief of the Inspectors Office of the Shanghai Public
Safety Bureau, was assassinated outside the lift on the
5th floor of the Sun Sun Hotel, Nanking Road. He was shot
in the abdomen from the effects of which he died not long
after. Huang's servant, Zung Yung Jing (余芳琴), also
received a bullet wound in his right abdomen when he
attempted to go to the rescue of his master. His condition
is serious.
Huang used to spend his leisure time with his
friends in the hotel. Room No.618 had been occupied by
a certain man named Tan (譚) for the past six months.
Huang was in the habit of visiting this place at 4 p.m.
everyday arriving in his private motor car. Yesterday
evening he did not go to the hotel until 9 p.m. He was
accompanied by his bodyguard named Zung Yung Jing. He
remained with his friend until 11 p.m. when he took his
leave intending to proceed home. As soon as he had left
the room, he was followed by two desperadoes to the lift.
He had just pushed the bell when the desperadoes immediately
approached and fired several shots at him bringing him to
the ground. The bodyguard, who was following immediately
behind Huang, saw the shooting and attempted to place
Huang in safety in the lift. The liftman, named Kuan
Pih Fah (管必發), age 29, native of Yangchow, immediately
closed the door and descended.
The shooting was heard throughout the hotel. A
number of foreign policemen who were dancing in the Sun
Sun Dance Hall, upon hearing the firing, rushed to the
lift and found Huang and his bodyguard lying in a pool
of blood. The Louza Police Station was immediately
notified, while the wounded persons were removed to the
Chinese Lester Hospital.
Huang received three bullet wounds; one in the
left waist, one in the left rib and one in the abdomen.
His bodyguard received one bullet in the abdomen. Huang
expired at 11.25 p.m., 15 minutes after entering the
hospital. The condition of his bodyguard is serious.
About 20 minutes after the tragedy, a male
Chinese, wearing a grey coloured Cantonese satin long
gown, white straw hat and black leather shoes, arrived
at the hotel and took the lift to the 5th floor. He
asked one of the boys whether there were any persons in
Room No.618 and was informed that it was unoccupied. The
man left, showing much uneasiness. Observing this, the
boy reported to the management. When the man descended
to the ground floor, detectives of the Louza Station
searched his person, and found a blood stain about the
size of a dollar near the 4th button on the left hand
side of his long gown. He was questioned about the
object of his intended visit to Room No.618, to which
he replied that he had desired to pay a short call.
Upon being questioned about the blood stain, the man
would not speak and was so greatly disturbed that his
face was covered with perspiration. He was taken to
the police station on suspicion. Upon arrival there,
he stated that his name was Yu Chia Shuan (余家善); that
he was a special service officer of the Public Safety
Bureau; that he had gone to Room No.618 to call on Huang

《中国时报》及其他本地报纸：

一名中国警官遇刺身亡。

5226
昨晚11时许，上海公安局督察处处长黄永华在南京路新新旅馆五楼电梯外遇刺。他腹部中枪，不久后身亡。黄的仆人余芳琴在试图救助主人时，右腹部亦中弹。情况危急。
黄常与朋友在旅馆消遣。618号房间在过去六个月中一直由一名姓谭的男子租用。黄习惯每天下午4点乘坐私人汽车到达此处。昨晚他直到9点才到旅馆。随行保镖名为余芳琴。他与朋友待到晚上11点，随后告辞准备回家。刚离开房间，两名歹徒便尾随他至电梯口。他刚按下铃，歹徒立即上前向他连开数枪，将其击倒在地。紧随黄身后的保镖目睹枪击，试图将黄安置进电梯以确保安全。电梯司机管必发，29岁，扬州人，立即关门下楼。
枪声传遍整个旅馆。几名正在新新舞厅跳舞的外国警察听到枪声后，冲向电梯，发现黄及其保镖躺在血泊中。老闸捕房随即接到通知，伤者被送往华人莱斯医院（Chinese Lester Hospital）。
黄身中三弹；一处在左腰，一处在左肋，一处在腹部。其保镖腹部中一弹。黄于入院15分钟后，即晚上11时25分死亡。其保镖情况危急。
惨案发生约20分钟后，一名身穿灰色粤缎长衫、头戴白色草帽、脚穿黑皮鞋的中国男子抵达旅馆，乘电梯至五楼。他询问一名侍者618号房间是否有人，得知无人后离开，神情显得十分不安。侍者察觉此状，遂向管理层报告。当该男子下至一楼时，老闸捕房的侦探对其搜身，在其长衫左侧第四颗纽扣附近发现一处约银元大小的血迹。当被问及前往618号房间的意图时，他回答说是想短暂拜访。当被问及血迹时，该男子不肯作答，且极度慌乱，满面汗水。他因涉嫌被带往警察局。到达警局后，他自称名为余家善；系公安局特务人员；因与同事黄永华交好，故前往618号房间拜访黄

August 26, 1933. Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

Yung Hwa with whom he was on friendly terms as a co-worker. He carried a licensed pistol. As to the blood stain, he explained that he had been to the hospital to inquire after Huang's condition and got the stain there. The man was released by the Police.
After shooting down Huang Yung Hwa and his bodyguard, the two assassins descended by the staircase and made good their escape.
According to eye-witnesses, the two assassins were described as being about 30 years of age and wore blue satin long gowns. After leaving the door of the hotel, they walked away quickly with head down with their left hands holding up their long gowns in such a way that the pistols they were carrying inside their clothing could be plainly seen. It is reported that these two men resembled in several ways the occupiers of a room of the same hotel who had taken the room in the name of Kao ( 高 ).
Huang Yung Hwa, age 31; native of Shaoshing, was the chief of the Inspectors Office of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau. He was responsible for the arrest last year of a leader of the Communist Party and was commended. He was stout and slightly pock-marked. He was very taciturn and always carried about with him a leather portfolio. He had a motor car. The late Inspector Ma Shao Wu ( 马绍武 ), who was murdered in the Siao Hwo Yoen ( 小花园 ) alleyway, was an assistant to Huang.

The Shun Pao (Comment):-

NO CHANGE IN CHINA'S FOREIGN POLICY

When it became known that Dr. Lo Wen Kan, Minister of Foreign Affairs, had been commissioned to inspect Sinkiang, the Japanese seized this opportunity to spread a rumour that China was about to change her foreign policy so much so that the Chinese people themselves began to suspect the attitude of the Government despite verbal denials and explanations.
Recently, a rumour was prevalent that T.V.Soong would call on certain Japanese notables. The people focused their attention on T.V.Soong and kept a close watch on his movements to ascertain whether there would be a real change of policy. Mr. T.V.Soong passed through Yokohama yesterday. He did not land and refused to grant interviews to Japanese newspapermen. This is sufficient to give the people a hint of the Government's policy. Mr. Soong has two more days to stay in Japan (on the steamer). What Mr. T.V.Soong will do during this period, we cannot foretell.
China's foreign policy is based on the resolution passed at the First Kuomintang Congress. This

杂项

永华。他携带有持枪许可证。关于血迹，他解释说是去医院探问黄的病情时沾上的。该男子被警方释放。
两名刺客在击倒黄永华及其保镖后，沿楼梯下楼并成功逃脱。
据目击者描述，两名刺客年龄约30岁，身穿蓝色缎面长衫。离开旅馆大门后，他们低头快步离去，左手撩起长衫，致使藏在衣内的手枪清晰可见。据报道，这两人在几个方面与该旅馆中以高姓名义开房的住客相似。
黄永华，31岁，绍兴人，系上海公安局督察处处长。他因去年逮捕了一名共产党领导人而受到嘉奖。他体型肥胖，略有麻点。他沉默寡言，总是随身携带一个皮公文包。他拥有一辆汽车。此前在小花园弄堂被谋杀的马绍武督察是黄的助手。

《顺天报》评论：

中国外交政策不变

当获悉外交部长罗文干博士受命视察新疆时，日本人借此机会散布谣言，称中国即将改变其外交政策，以至于尽管政府口头否认并解释，中国民众自己也开始怀疑政府的态度。
最近，有谣言盛传宋子文将拜访某些日本名流。民众将注意力集中在宋子文身上，密切关注其行踪，以确认政策是否真的会有变化。宋子文先生昨日途经横滨。他未上岸，并拒绝接受日本记者的采访。这足以给民众暗示政府的政策。宋先生在日本（在轮船上）还将停留两天。在此期间宋子文先生将做什么，我们无法预测。
中国的外交政策基于国民党第一次全国代表大会通过的决议。此

The local Kuomintang on August 25 issued a
circular notice instructing local bodies to join
before August 27 the movement undertaken by the
Chinese Chamber of Commerce, etc. in arranging to
welcome the return of the Minister of Finance from
Europe.

D 5226
Assassination of Nanking Political Agent
Huang Yung-hua (黄永华), an agent of the Central
Political Council attached to the local Bureau of
Public Safety for investigation into communistic
activity, was shot and fatally wounded by three men
as he was entering the lift of the Sun Sun Hotel at
about 11 p.m. on August 25. Huang's servant, who was
with him at the time, was seriously wounded. The
assassins, who are thought to be hirelings of the
Communist Party, made good their escape.
